name: Support & Resistance
description: Calculate support and resistance levels using multiple methods

fields.label: Symbol
fields.description: The ticker symbol for the asset being analyzed (e.g. AAPL, BTCUSDT).

fields.label: Timeframe
fields.description: The timeframe/interval of the candle data (e.g. 1m, 5m, 1h, 1d).

fields.label: Lookback Period
fields.description: Number of periods to analyze. CALCULATE based on data timeframe: For 3-month daily data use 20-30, for 6-month use 40-60, for 1-year use 50-100. Consider the stock's typical price cycle length.

fields.label: Sensitivity (%)
fields.description: Percentage threshold for grouping nearby levels. CALCULATE from volatility: Check the stock's average daily price movement. Low volatility (<2% daily) use 0.5-1.0%, medium volatility (2-4%) use 1.0-2.0%, high volatility (>4%) use 2.0-3.0%.

fields.label: Number of Levels
fields.description: Maximum support and resistance levels to return. DECIDE based on analysis goal: For quick buy/sell decision use 2-3, for detailed technical analysis use 4-5, for identifying major zones use 2.
